items.bold: TRUMP: Ceasefire on "MASSIVE LIFE SUPPORT." Iran made nuclear concessions — but "NOT ENOUGH." Combat resumption aides considering.
items.text: CNN live (15 minutes ago) and CBS News confirmed: Trump told CBS News on Monday that the monthlong ceasefire between the US and Iran is on "massive life support." Critically: Trump said Iran's latest response DID make concessions on the nuclear issue — but said they were "not enough." This is the most important diplomatic signal of overnight: Iran's letter was NOT a total rejection on nuclear — it included some nuclear movement. Trump said a possible resumption of Project Freedom would be "much more severe" than the original operation. CNN: some Trump aides said he is now more seriously considering a resumption of major combat operations in Iran. The ceasefire is alive — barely — but the military option is being actively re-evaluated at the highest levels of the Trump administration.

items.bold: SAUDI ARAMCO CEO NASSER: "If delayed a few more weeks, normalisation will last INTO 2027." Pre-war prices not coming back soon.
items.text: CNN live (15 minutes ago) confirmed: Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser told analysts on a conference call Monday: "If the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is delayed by a few more weeks, then normalisation will last into 2027." He added that even if the vital waterway were to reopen today, Aramco warns it would "still take months for the market to rebalance." CNN: "In other words, even in the best-case scenario, pre-war lower energy prices are most likely not coming back anytime soon. With the Strait of Hormuz remaining closed, the world has been rapidly drawing down oil inventories, which act as shock absorbers for the system." This is the most important oil market statement of the 74-day war from a primary market participant. Aramco is the world's largest oil exporter — its CEO saying normalisation extends into 2027 is not commentary, it is a supply chain forecast from the source.

items.bold: US SANCTIONED 12 COMPANIES facilitating IRANIAN OIL TO CHINA — days before Trump-Xi Beijing meeting.
items.text: CNN live confirmed: The Trump administration on Monday imposed sanctions on 12 companies and individuals it says are helping to facilitate the sale and shipment of oil from Iran to China. Treasury Secretary Bessent: the agency will "continue to cut the Iranian regime off from the financial networks it uses to carry out terrorist acts and to destabilize the global economy." The timing — days before Trump meets Xi in Beijing — is deliberate maximum pressure: sanctioning Chinese companies while simultaneously planning to discuss Hormuz with Xi. CNN: US intelligence indicated China was preparing to deliver new air defense systems to Iran, according to three people familiar with recent intelligence assessments. China support for Iran and possible air defense delivery will be a key topic in Beijing. The sanctions before Beijing = Trump applying pressure on Xi before the meeting, not after.

items.bold: CNN SOURCE: Talks "depend on results of Trump's Beijing visit." ARAGHCHI likely in DELHI for BRICS — same days as Trump-Xi.
items.text: CNN live (15 minutes ago) confirmed: Talks between the US and Iran won't make significant progress before Trump meets Xi Jinping later this week, according to a regional source close to the negotiations process. The source told CNN that movement on the talks will "depend on the results of President Trump's visit to Beijing." The source also pointed out that it was "very likely" that Iranian FM Araghchi will be in Delhi for the BRICS Foreign Ministers' meeting on Thursday and Friday — the same days that Trump is in Beijing for Trump-Xi talks. This creates a unique and extraordinary India diplomatic opportunity: EAM Jaishankar will be hosting both the BRICS ministers AND will be at the same meeting as Araghchi — giving India direct bilateral diplomatic access to the Iranian FM at a moment when the entire war's resolution depends on what happens in Beijing. India can be both a BRICS host and a quiet US-Iran back-channel simultaneously.

assessment.body:
Tuesday 8:00 AM IST. Day 74. The war's resolution now depends on what happens in two cities simultaneously — Beijing and Delhi.

WHAT TRUMP ACTUALLY SAID ON CBS
"Massive life support" — the ceasefire is alive but barely.
"Iran DID make concessions on nuclear — but not enough" — this is the critical revelation. The nuclear gap is about degree, not principle. Iran moved. Trump wants more.
"Project Freedom resumption would be MUCH MORE SEVERE" — military option being escalated, not just reactivated.
Trump aides: more seriously considering major combat resumption.

THE ARAMCO CEO WARNING — THE MOST IMPORTANT OIL STATEMENT OF THE WAR
Amin Nasser (Monday conference call, world's largest oil company CEO):
• "If delayed a few more weeks — normalisation into 2027"
• "Even if reopened TODAY — still take months to rebalance"
• "Pre-war prices most likely not coming back anytime soon"
This is not an analyst's opinion. This is the Saudi Aramco CEO — who controls the world's largest oil supply — telling the market that even in the best case, the oil price relief is months away.

THE BEIJING-DELHI CONVERGENCE
Thursday and Friday: Trump-Xi in Beijing. Araghchi at BRICS in Delhi.
Both happening simultaneously. Both decisive.
• Beijing: Xi can deliver Chinese pressure on Iran — the one leverage point no one else has
• Delhi: Jaishankar can engage Araghchi directly — raising Indian tanker coordination, Hormuz access, fertiliser, seafarers
• India is simultaneously the BRICS host and a potential US-Iran back-channel
• This is India's most diplomatically significant week since the war began February 28

THE CHINA SANCTIONS BEFORE BEIJING
• 12 companies sanctioned for facilitating Iranian oil to China — before the meeting
• US intelligence: China preparing to deliver air defense systems to Iran
• Trump is applying pressure before Beijing, not after
• If Xi helps: sanctions ease. If Xi doesn't: sanctions escalate
• China air defense for Iran = fundamentally changes the military balance in Hormuz

INDIA's TUESDAY AND WEEK AHEAD
• Tuesday open: cautious. Nifty support 23,600-23,800. Recovery depends on Trump-Xi.
• OMC hike before May 15: ESSENTIAL regardless of deal. Aramco confirmed — pre-war prices not coming back anytime soon. Rs 30,000 Cr/month OMC losses cannot wait.
• Araghchi BRICS Delhi: India must prepare specific Hormuz agenda NOW — Indian tanker coordination, kharif fertiliser corridor, 280 seafarers, OMC import continuity.
• Kharif fertiliser: BRICS meeting is the best and last opportunity to negotiate a coordinated Gulf fertiliser shipment before June planting window closes.

VERDICT: Day 74 opens with the war's resolution converging on two simultaneous meetings — Trump-Xi in Beijing and Araghchi at BRICS in Delhi. The Aramco CEO has told the world that even a deal this week means months of elevated prices. Trump has revealed Iran moved on nuclear but not enough. The ceasefire is on massive life support. And India sits at the center of both diplomatic tracks — hosting Araghchi while Trump meets Xi. India's week at BRICS is not just a multilateral courtesy. It is India's most important diplomatic intervention in the war that has cost its economy Rs 50+ trillion since February 28.
